programme.title: Universal Soldier II: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Luc and Veronica recover and revive Luc's long-lost brother who has been suspended in a cryo-chamber for decades and attempt to expose the Unisol program, led by Mazur (Gary Busey), which recycles dead soldiers in the attempt to create the ultimate mercenary army.

programme.title: Universal Soldier III: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Veronica and Luc conclude their quest to expose the Unisol program to the media and destroy Mentor's (Burt Reynolds) billion dollar heist, while the evil Dr. Walker creates a genetically engineered Unisol GR87, programmed with the single mission to destroy Luc and Veronica.

programme.title: 12 Hours to Live
programme.desc: 18 year old Amy is kidnapped by a deranged gunman wanted for the murder of an FBI Agent and FBI Agent Megan is hot on his trail. When it's learned that Amy is a type-1 diabetic, Megan must once again confront the man who violently killed her partner to save Amy.

programme.title: Captive Hearts
programme.desc: A finance executive is mysteriously kidnapped and when the hostage takers send video demands directly to the man’s wife, a lone police officer, Detective Kelsoe, has his suspicions.

programme.title: Criminal Intent
programme.desc: Devon thought that his share of difficulties were over after a difficult divorce but on the road to rebuilding his life, tragedy strikes leaving him in a fight for his freedom and his innocence.

programme.title: Double Cross
programme.desc: Kathy Swanson and her neighbor, Sheryl, are both having difficulty with their husbands. So when Sheryl suggests to Kathy that they should get their lives back by killing each other’s husbands, Kathy facetiously sanctions the plan.

programme.title: Last Chance Cafe
programme.desc: After uncovering evidence that her stepfather was murdered by a ring of corrupt cops and judges, including her DA ex-husband, a woman is forced to flee with her daughter and hide in a small farming town, where she falls for a local ranch owner but danger soon follows.

programme.title: Max Havoc: Curse of the Dragon
programme.desc: Exotic action/adventure and martial arts blend together as Max Havoc, world famous kickboxer turned sports photographer, faces the relentless Black Dragons in a reluctant quest to save the lovely Goody sisters and to avenge the death of good friend Tahsi in Guam.

programme.title: Max Havoc: Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Max Havoc is on a new assignment staying at a luxury hotel in the heart of a big city only to discover that the classy hotel owner is a vicious mob boss heading up a crime ring full of unwanted teenagers in the nearby slums.

programme.title: San Saba
programme.desc: Private Investigator Bud wakes from a coma in a hospital room and is immediately charged with murder but did he do it or was he framed? As the story unfolds in flashback, Bud discovers that no one seems to be who he or she claim to be and everyone's motives are suspect.

Sylvia undergoes a horrifying physical transformation, and she finds herself drawn into a persecuted underworld where she begins an astonishing journey of freakish self-discovery. programme.title: Early Grave
programme.desc: On the eve of their ten year high school reunion, six people are summoned to the isolated country estate of one of their former friends, now a famous horror writer. Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. Seven friends find themselves in a struggle to survive and outwit a diabolical killer who is savagely committed to sending them all to an EARLY GRAVE...

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a mysterious crash and uncovers more than an object, but a massive government conspiracy. Inspired by the real life events of December 9, 1965 and one of America's most mysterious UFO incidents...

programme.title: Witch Trials
programme.desc: Two documentary filmmakers and an ex-cop investigate the disappearance of a young girl that is rumored to have been abducted by a witch in the haunted woods of Connecticut...

programme.title: Ouija Room
programme.desc: An agoraphobic woman with autism begins summoning spirits to be her friends while her brother/caretaker is gone during the day, but the more time she spends with the spirits the more it becomes clear they aren't so friendly after all...

programme.title: Haunted
programme.desc: An aspiring writer pays a visit to his sister to look after her house while she is out of town, but what he finds there is more terrifying than any of the stories he writes...

programme.title: Van Helsing

programme.desc: On Halloween a couple, both of which are clairvoyants, drive to a cemetery. They go for fun to pick up vibrations from the tombstones of the deceased. In the midst of all of this, they are being stalked by a dark shadowy figure. What starts out as some Halloween fun quickly turns to terror...

programme.title: Slasher.com
programme.desc: After meeting online, Jack and Kristy go on a weekend getaway to the woodlands of rural Missouri. While discovering each other, they soon learn of the terrorizing horrors that the forest has in store...

programme.desc: The Bloody Hand tells the story of a student named Hien who studies in Little Saigon. Her peaceful life completely changes when the young girl rents a room that was once owned by Lien the daughter of the landlord, who was kidnapped, raped and killed by five criminals, who were never caught...

programme.title: The Devil's Fairground
programme.desc: Starring Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson and John Charles Dickson. The Stars of two competing and colliding paranormal television shows converge on an abandoned haunted amusement park which ends up being the epicenter to hell. They are now all trapped - in an all out war against pure evil...

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: A young Nurse is assigned to look after a patient in a remote location in the English countryside. As the night continues she finds herself terrorized by an unseen force that is connected with her patient...

programme.title: Ouija Hosts
programme.desc: Presenters of paranormal TV show "Ghost Hosts" are filming in an abandoned haunted building as part of a Halloween special. The stories surrounding the horrifying ghosts of the mansion are about to become reality...

programme.title: The Devil's Forest
programme.desc: Rachel and her team of film makers travel to Transylvania, Romania, to document the paranormal phenomena within Hoia-Baciu Forest...

programme.title: Ghost Boat
programme.desc: Trapped aboard the family yacht, Samantha lives out her personal Hell, night after night, answering to the cruel and painful demands of the ship's alarm system. Taking a journey into the depths of depravity, she wakes each morning to the disfiguring scars left by the previous night's horror and searches for the answer to a missing memory: 'Could I have killed my family... Or did Hell get it wrong?

programme.desc: Rose awakes in an unknown house following a serious car accident with memory loss and no ability to walk. Her Mother and boyfriend are there to help her. Rose wants to piece together her life before the accident. All is not what it seems...

programme.title: Island of the Dolls

programme.title: The Cult of Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: A group of troubled teen girls and their teacher must fight for survival after discovering a cult has brought Humpty Dumpty, a killer doll, back to life and set loose on the camp where they are staying...

programme.title: Red Summer
programme.desc: Four young people come to Mallorca to enjoy idyllic summer holidays, but delving into the most inhospitable places on the island will begin a hellish journey...

programme.title: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When a psychiatric doctor researches a young girls' diary to find out why she murdered her entire family, he begins to fall into the same state of insomnia and confusion that led her to lose her mind...

programme.title: Doctor Carver
programme.desc: A group of ladies seeking the perfect faces soon realise when they conjure a demonic plastic surgeon, that no surgery comes without a price...

programme.title: The Demon's Child
programme.desc: In search for her missing sister, a young woman takes a job as a nurse to a young boy in a coma and hunts for clues in his sinister family home...

programme.title: Goatman
programme.desc: A news reporter and her crew investigating the legend of "Goatman" in a dense forest find themselves in danger, getting a bigger story than any of them could imagine...

programme.title: Demonic Plastic Surgeon, MD
programme.desc: At an elderly peoples home, a demonic plastic surgeon has been summoned. And soon, they will all be due a make over...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono

Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: El Resurgir de la Momia
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta a una momia ancestral. Tras quedar atrapados en un bucle temporal, la única forma de escapar es derrotarla. A medida que aumenta el número de cadáveres, parece que la Momia debe recolectar las almas de quienes la despertaron para poder caminar sobre la tierra, para siempre...

programme.title: Jack y Jill 3
programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0

El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas.

programme.title: 48 Horas de Terror
programme.desc: Mateo un escritor citadino adquiere una casa de campo en donde planea vivir con su esposa y escribir en la tranquilidad del campo, pero no tomo en cuenta las trágicas noticias de los acontecimientos de canibalismo que ocurrieron a manos de sus vecinos quienes solo buscan sacias su hambre.

programme.title: Terror En La Montaña
programme.desc: Un soldado regresa a su país tras participar en la Guerra de las Malvinas y descubre que su esposa lo engaña con un alto político.

programme.title: La Araña Vampiro
programme.desc: Jerónimo tiene 20 años y está medicado con psicofármacos. Su padre piensa que unos días en un entorno natural pueden curarlo y decide llevarlo a una casa perdida en la montaña.

programme.title: Beber de tu Sangre
programme.desc: Una vampira se enamora de un hombre que conoció en un bar. Un vampiro invita a una mujer embarazada y a sus amigos a ver su obra de teatro. Estos dos vampiros son marido y mujer. Pero Ala ni y Gabriel son una pareja de vampiros aburridos de su larga vida en pareja. Ella decide tener un hijo, pero él no lo desea. Los problemas empiezan cuando Ala ni conoce y se enamora de Javier, pero no sabe que está casado con Lizvet y mucho menos que va a tener un hijo con ella.

programme.title: Witnesses
programme.desc: In this first episode of the new Bigfoot Documentary Series, "I Believe in Bigfoot," Bigfoot eyewitnesses recount their horrifying and amazing encounters with the monster we call Sasquatch or Bigfoot! Witness testimonies include interviews from Turtleman of "Call of the Wild Man," Mountain Man from "Duck Dynasty," David Bakara from the Expedition Bigfoot Museum, Michael Cook who was featured on "These Woods are Haunted" and many more! Stay till the end and see never before seen footage of our own Bigfoot investigations that confirm some truly bizarre and disturbing Bigfoot witness testimony! Why are so many people telling such similar and terrifying stories of Bigfoot? Is this creature real? Is Bigfoot truly a relic hominid or is it something very different? Is Bigfoot something much more sinister?

programme.title: Voices From The Void
programme.desc: In this episode of the new Bigfoot documentary series "I Believe in Bigfoot" we explore what many people consider to be the best evidence for Bigfoot! The Sierra Sounds. These Bigfoot vocalizations were Recorded by Ron Morehead and Al Berry and have been hotly debated since the 1970’s. Television shows like “The Truth is Out There" have used these recordings to compare other Bigfoot vocalizations. Even Joe Rogan has even chimed in on the validity of the evidence of the Sierra Sounds on the Joe Rogan Experience. In this chapter of "I Believe in Bigfoot" Ron Morehead lays out his classic Bigfoot story and shares a timeline of this series of Sasquatch encounters that if fully understood and appreciated by mainstream science should rework our understanding of what a Bigfoot actually may be. What do you think? Are the Sierra Sounds the Best evidence yet for Bigfoot?

programme.title: Into The Void
programme.desc: In the third chapter of the New Bigfoot Documentary "I Believe in Bigfoot" The hunt for the Sasquatch begins! Filmmaker Kelley Lockman goes from documentarian to Bigfoot investigator in this installment of "I Believe in Bigfoot." The "Squatch Watchers" invite Kelley and Ron Morehead to explore a Bigfoot habitation that they have been investigating and much excitement ensues! First "The Squatch Watchers" take them on a tour of the property where multiple eyewitnesses have seen and interacted with Bigfoot. They show off their Bigfoot gifting area and the site of a Sasquatch track that they cast. Then the hunt begins! A mysterious area that "Squatch Watcher" David Martin has a bad feeling about delivers some bigfoot action. Rocks are thrown and new Bigfoot discoveries are made! Watch as the Bigfoot investigation, which would span over the course of six months, begins! Join Ron Morehead, "The Squatch Watchers," and Kelley Lockman as they go "Into the Void!"

programme.title: Alien and UFO Encounters: The Top 20
programme.desc: These 20 hair-raising stories of extra-terrestrial encounters, crashes, and abductions provide clear proof that there are aliens among us.

programme.title: Beyond the Spectrum: Being Taken
programme.desc: Alien Abduction. Is it a positive experience? A negative one? Is it even a real thing? With so many debatable cases, most of them years in the past, is it even possible to know the truth? Join Darcy Weir and Lee Lustig on another Occult Journey in Being Taken. Explore the rich and detailed history of supposed alien abductions and the most credible cases from a whole new perspective.

programme.title: Dark Ops Exposed: ET Bases, Bioweapons and Mutants
programme.desc: Paranormal and UFO encounters have occurred on military installations around the globe. What lies behind these strange occurrences?

programme.title: Mythical Monsters
programme.desc: The kraken, griffins, dragons, and even the chupacabra... Are they real? Or merely the product of legends and folklore? Follow us as we delve deep into the facts in this terrifying journey with Mythical Monsters.

programme.title: The Columbia Mountains
programme.desc: For centuries, the indigenous peoples of Canada’s Columbia Mountains have maintained that they share their traditional territory with mountain-dwelling giants who abide in the region’s most desolate crags and canyons. In this video, we delve into classic wildman stories from the West Kootenays and Wells Gray Provincial Park.

programme.title: The Okanagan
programme.desc: For centuries, B.C.’s Interior Plateau has been inhabited by four Interior Salish nations, all of whom have traditional stories about wild giants with a penchant for kidnapping humans. In this episode, we take a look at wildman stories from Okanagan Country, British Columbia.

Mindful hustle is the idea that you can be productive while pausing your mind throughout the day to stay present. By cultivating mindfulness throughout your day, you can avoid much of the stress that builds over the day.

programme.title: Setting Your Goals - Here's How To Achieve The Goals You Set
programme.desc: So many of us set big (or small) goals in life, but the reality is that so few of us hit those goals we set. If you want to achieve and surpass those goals, you need a reliable process to get you there. In this video, I will teach you exactly how to set goals in a way that pushes you toward them.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.title: Flying Cars, Holographic Food, & Autonomous Firefighters
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Rafi Yoeli, who spent the last 30 years designing Flying Cars, Taxis & Rescue Vehicles. Also, see Holographic food menus, ordering, and drones that fly into burning buildings to warn the Fire Fighters before they venture in and risk their lives.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. We also visit an aeronautics technology fund, enhancing our air travel, and watch Jonnys connected car get hacked and taken over by a trained cybersecurity expert!

programme.title: Are You as Passionate as You Say You Are?

In each episode of the show, entrepreneurs are challenged to step into an elevator and pitch their business on camera to a board of investors in 60 seconds or less. If the investors like what they hear, the elevator doors open to reveal the boardroom, and contestants have the chance to walk away with life-changing funding, mentorship from the smartest minds in business and a personal and brand-defining moment.

programme.title: Sink or Swim With This Professional Mermaid's Business Idea

While most people would have hit pause, she instead reimagined her offering and The Messy Cookie home kit was born. Big names like Wayfair and Ebay jumped on board for her delicious virtual team-building escape. But while shes been able to get in the virtual door once shes struggled to get repeat custom from the big companies. Whats holding her back?

But he is struggling to translate enthusiastic investor meetings into cash commitments.

programme.title: Take More Risk. Don't Let Fear Stop You

Other topics in this episode include: - Why Your Appearance Matters - Types of Loans for Your Business - Patience is Essential for Business Success - How to Build Generational Wealth - How to Better Automate Time and Project Management In Your Business

programme.title: Developing Profitable Partnerships
programme.desc: Harlem’s Fashion Row founder Brandice Daniel creates bridges between fashion designers of color and mainstream brands such as Nike, Gap, Target, Marriott, and Coca-Cola

programme.title: Fireside Chat Leading America's Financial Freedom Movement
programme.desc: Operation HOPE CEO John Hope Bryant joins BLACK ENTERPRISE CEO Earl “Butch” Graves Jr. to discuss financial inclusion, economic empowerment, and wealth creation as the civil rights issues of our time.

programme.title: Diversifying Fashion for the Next Generation
programme.desc: Shaw Bernard, founder of Black-owned, woman-owned agency STRUT Models, is building a more inclusive industry one model at a time

programme.title: What It Takes to Win at ESPN with David Roberts
programme.desc: In this episode of BE the Game, ESPN Executive Vice president and Executive Editor of Sports, News and Entertainment, shares his journey to the top spot of one of sports major news organizations with Black Enterprise Executive Editor and Host Alfred Edmond.

programme.title: Navigating Corporate Success With Jeannine K Brown
programme.desc: Getting hired in a new job can be an exciting step forward for those carving out career paths. At the same time, the journey to success can be elusive. Navigating the ins and outs of the corporate world and trying to get ahead isn’t always easy when you’re unsure how to get promoted and move up the corporate ladder. Jeannine K. Brown, founder of Everyday Lead and author of Unstuck and Unstoppable, understands the complexities of getting ahead in a corporate role. In this episode, Brown discussed ways to learn the art of self-promotion. Beyond addressing the challenges in larger corporate settings, Brown's principles are relevant for small businesses aiming to foster a culture of success.

programme.title: Performing Under Pressure
programme.desc: Learn how to manage workplace pressure, build emotional resilience, and protect your mental health through proactive strategies and healthier lifestyle choices.

programme.title: Don't Try to Hide Personal from Business on Social Media
programme.desc: Many business owners ask if they can post personal and business on social media. YES, it's good to share your personal life, to some degree on your business oriented social media. However, if you're trying to have something "hidden" then don't. Share things you don't want anyone to see on restricted platforms like What's App. Twitter(X) changed it's blocked user settings, to allow people to see your posts, even though you've blocked them. Other things covered on The Rundown with Ramon include: -Evaluating business idea viability -Seth Godin's writing advice on brevity -LinkedIn's AI job recruitment tools -Oura Smart Ring review -Health considerations for entrepreneurs over 40 -Hard vs. soft luggage debate -Making meaningful professional connections -Twitter/X's blocking feature update -Building startups while maintaining mental health

programme.title: Fat Joe Promises to Amplify The Culture With His New Talk Show
programme.desc: Fat Joe takes us inside his new weekly talk show hosted and executive-produced by the Grammy-nominated artist and cultural icon. The show sees the hip-hop superstar bring the audience along for intimate conversations and recall unheard stories with some of America's biggest names. Fat Joe will drive the discussion in ways that only he can.

programme.title: Daymond John Brings Black Entrepreneurs Day to Atlanta For The First Time
programme.desc: Business Mogul and Shark Tank star, Daymond John takes us inside the 5th Annual Black Entrepreneurs Day (BED) which will be held in Atlanta for the first time on November 22. The Fubu creator and serial investor shares what makes this year's BED so special.

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Episode 9: TRY TRY AGAIN
programme.desc: Remba believes that she can learn to the play borzzlehorn just by listening to it. Yip believes that he can learn to jump rope just by watching Taco.

programme.title: Episode 10: A LITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
programme.desc: A magical dazzle kite draws pictures in the sky, alerting Bommi and friends to others in need. In a fun sequence of adventures, everyone realizes how friendships are made stronger

programme.title: Episode 11: A TAILING TALE
programme.desc: Razzle Dazzle Day celebrates the uniqueness of Dazzle Land with a Surprise Dazzle. But it only happens if all the friends are together at sunset ...

programme.title: Episode 12: THE BIG CLEAN
programme.desc: Unusual Clean-up Weather is heading the way of Bommi and Friends! After the falling soap bubbles, the rain and the drying wind machines, it's time to put everything away

programme.title: Episode 13: THE GREAT RACE
programme.desc: It's the great Fazzmobile Relay Race and Maya has promised Yip that he can drive one of the Fazzmobiles. However, she reconsiders and decides to drive it herself, breaking her promise to Yip.

programme.title: Episode 1: GREETINGS FROM DAZZLE LAND
programme.desc: In the first episode, Bommi's dream comes true when her book Libro comes to life and magically transports her into Dazzle Land where she meets her life-long, pop-up book friends.

programme.title: Episode 2: SNOOGLE BERRY DELIGHT
programme.desc: Picking, sorting, juicing and baking Dazzle Land's colorful Snoogleberries can be a lot of fun, if you follow the directions. It takes teamwork and an imaginative Dazzle to sort things out again.

programme.title: Episode 3: CHEARS FOR FEAR
programme.desc: In a Dazzle Land amusement park, Bommi and her friends confront different things that they fear, such as heights and darkness. All except Rumba, why?

programme.title: Episode 4: A TACO TALE
programme.desc: On Dazzle Land Beach Day, Taco borrows Remba's beautiful Snazzle Bedazzle Shell necklace. When he accidentally loses it, he doesn't immediately tell the truth, leading to difficult situations..

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Fruitvale Station

programme.title: 500 Days of Summer
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Childhood friends Monica and Quincy both aspire to professional basketball careers. Over eleven years, their paths intertwine as they navigate their passionate relationship alongside their athletic ambitions, learning that love requires the same dedication and sacrifice as sports.

programme.title: What Men Want
programme.desc: Sports agent Ali Davis is passed over for a promotion in her male-dominated profession. After a mystic encounter gives her the ability to hear men's thoughts, she uses this power to succeed in her career and gain an edge, but learns unexpected lessons about relationships and herself.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Based on a true story, professor Melvin B. Tolson inspires students at historically black Wiley College to form a debate team in 1930s Texas. They challenge racial prejudice and inequality, ultimately competing against Harvard University in a groundbreaking championship match.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: To escape neighborhood bully Deebo, Craig moves to the suburbs to live with his uncle and cousin Day-Day. What should be a peaceful change becomes complicated when they encounter new troubles including thieves, romantic interests, and neighborhood conflicts in Rancho Cucamonga.

programme.title: All About The Benjamins
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson teams with small-time con artist Reggie Wright, the man he's been pursuing, to locate missing diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions. The unlikely partners race against criminals in this action-comedy about money, survival, and unexpected friendship.

programme.title: Baby Boy
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Jody lives with his mother while fathering children with two different women. When his mother's new boyfriend moves in, Jody is forced to confront his immaturity and finally grow up, facing the commitments and responsibilities of real life as an African-American man.

programme.title: Drillbit Taylor
programme.desc: Three high school freshmen hire a low-budget bodyguard to protect them from bullies. The man claiming to be a special ops veteran is actually a homeless con artist, but he develops genuine affection for the kids while teaching them to stand up for themselves.

programme.title: The Bachelor Weekend (The Stag)
programme.desc: An Irish groom's brother plans a hiking trip bachelor party with a no-women rule. When the groom's fiancée's brother shows up with his girlfriend, tensions arise. The weekend camping trip becomes a test of friendships, masculinity, and relationships in the wilderness.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 007: Morning Routines That Trend, CONCACAF Nations League Soccer, & Jordan 4 Bricks Review
programme.desc: This week's episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast as Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith unpack the latest trends in morning routines that are sweeping the nation. Plus, don't miss their exclusive review of the sneaker of the year, the Jordan 4 "Bricks" by Nigel Sylvester.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 008: Avatar's Return, Nokia's Viral Video, Coachella Hype, NBA's Marketing Moves, NFL Rule Changes
programme.desc: Episode 008 of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith delve into the buzz surrounding the upcoming Avatar movie, discussing its potential impact and fan expectations. They analyze Nokia's latest music video that's taking the internet by storm and share their excitement for the approaching Coachella festival, highlighting anticipated performances and trends. The conversation shifts to the NBA, where they examine recent player suspensions and debate whether marketing strategies are influencing league decisions more than ever. They also unpack the NFL's new rule changes for 2025, exploring how adjustments to overtime and kickoff rules could affect game dynamics and betting landscapes . To top it all off, the hosts open a pack of Dragon Ball Z trading cards, aiming for those elusive God Rare cards, and discuss the thrill of collecting and the value of rare finds .

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 009: Coachella Special With The Girls! Festival Drama, Prismatic Evolutions & Dire Wolves Return?
programme.desc: Get festival-ready with this special Coachella episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast! Michelangelo also shares highlights from an unforgettable weekend with El Cristiano Tequila. Plus, they dive into the astonishing news of scientists bringing back an extinct species—the Dire Wolf. Don't miss this episode packed with festival tips, rare Pokémon cards, wild stories, and mind-blowing science news!
